name: hydra
description: Claude leads, cheaper Command Code agents (Heads) implement: /hydra turns it on, /heads watches them live, /hydra-usage shows both sides' limits

headModel.title: Hydra head model
headModel.description: Command Code model the Heads run on

headsWeeklyUsd.title: Command Code weekly limit (USD)
headsWeeklyUsd.description: Your plan's weekly spend cap in USD; 0 shows spend without a limit

headsPlan.title: Command Code plan
headsPlan.description: Your Command Code plan name, shown in /hydra-usage (optional)
